race.comment: BLATANT VIOLATION (4) pushed forward last time and boxed on to finish 2.5 lengths away in third over 1000m at Carnarvon. Will again be prominent from the outset. Suitably placed so anticipating another big run. TAKE THE FIELD (1) raced on the speed from the outset last start and finished second, beaten 0.8 lengths, over 1400m at Port Hedland. Likely improver with strong prospects. MINOZZA (3) is yet to break through in five runs. Finished fifth at his last appearance over 1400m at Port Hedland on July 12. Solid top-three chance on his best figures. MARITIME DREAM (10) pushed forward last time and boxed on to finish third over 1400m at Port Hedland. Yet to find winning form this prep but has been thereabouts with two placings from three starts. Deserves respect on her best figures. HALF TIME SIREN (5) can feature in the finish third-up into the campaign.
